summary: Branch autoreview (quality lens): the repo-kind classification is coherent and well-factored — one shared is_harness_source_repo seam, product_path takes the effective kind, the quickfix pins it at start. The lock, marker plan-only rule, and opaque/copy accounting are clearly separated and commented. The change is bounded to pre_tool_use.py + quickfix.py + repo_kind.py + tests.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Exotic cp/mv forms (attached -tDIR, bare mv of a dir, git mv into a dir) are not fully parsed by the write-target extractor — a budget mis-count / drift-ceiling residual, documented in decision 0030.

residual_risks: Per decision 0013/0030, the Bash guard is drift-defense not an adversarial sandbox: exotic copy/move forms and arbitrary code (python -c, find -delete) can mis-count or evade the quickfix budget. This is never a lock disarm (the quickfix repo-kind PIN keeps classification correct regardless); the machinery change is visible in the diff and verify/autoreview/pr_ready are the backstop.
